title: List of Indonesian provinces by Human Development Index
html:
This is a list of Indonesian provinces by Human Development Index as of 2025. The data are regularly published every year by Statistics Indonesia.[1] Below also contains list of cities and regencies that has classification of very high HDI as of 2025, as well as historical data of HDI of Indonesian provinces.

This article is part of a series on
Subdivisions of Indonesia
Level 1
  • Provinces (provinsi or daerah istimewa or daerah khusus)
(GDP; GDP per capita; HDI; poverty rate); Island population)
Level 2
  • Regencies (kabupaten)
  • Cities (kota)
  • Metropolitan (metropolitan)
(full list; cities by GDP; regencies by GDP; cities by population; regencies by population)
Level 3
  • Districts
(kecamatan, distrik, kapanewon, or kemantren)
Level 4
  • Rural or urban villages
(desa or kelurahan)
